Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
DOOR HINGES FOR MACHINE TOOLS 



( Reaffirmed 2001 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements for door hinges for machine tools. 
1.1 These hinges are for cast or heavy type fabricated doors for machine tools. 

2. Types 

a) Type A 

b) Type B

4, Designation — Door hinge. Type B, having size t/ = 6 mm with tolerance E8 shad be designated 
as: 

Door Hinge B6-E8 1^ : 12242 

5, Material —- Free cutting steel conforming to IS : 4431-1978 'Specification for carbon and carbon- 
manganese free cutting steel ( first revision )'. 

6, Worirmanshsp — The hinges shall be free from cracks, burrs,, pits and other defects. 

7, Preservation and Packings 

7.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment like blackening, phosphating, etc, shall be given to the 
door hinges. 

7.2 The door hinges shall be packed in accordance with the best trade practice. 

8, Marking — Door hinges shal! be marked at an appropriate place with designation aud mannf acturer's 
name and trade-mark. 

8.1 Certiftcathn Marking— Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Standardization of sizes of the hinges used with the machine tool doors was felt necessary 
in order to have interchangeability. 

This standard has been formulated based upon the experience of the industry. The sizes and 
types specified are generally used by the machine tool builders.
